thesis: Pre-open pack for 2026-06-09 has one dated macro item ('Oil prices fall on Iran deal; S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rise') that is mildly constructive for broad equities, but it's a single pre-market futures-direction headline, and a companion item ('European shares steady; Middle East tensions in focus') signals the situation is still unsettled. The rest of the pack is single-name AI/IPO/M&A commentary and routine politician PTR filings, none actionable for a diversified core-ETF sleeve. A mixed, thin signal doesn't clear the bar for adding risk under a capital-preservation mandate. Existing VTI position (~21.8 of ~106.8 equity, ~20%) and cash buffer (~85, ~80% of equity, well above the 25% floor) remain within all tier limits (1 of max 4 positions, no name near the 25% cap). Holding rather than trading on a single futures headline.
